verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, API, or agent connector. The llms.txt file only offers crawler guidance for AI models, which is adjacent and does not let an agent connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
